items.source: The returned class array will contain all static nested classes of the supplied class that meet the requirements for @Configuration class implementations as specified in the documentation for @Configuration.
items.translation: 返回的类数组将包含满足文档中为@Configuration类实现指定的要求的所提供类的全部静态嵌套类。

items.source: The implementation of this method adheres to the contract defined in the SmartContextLoader SPI. Specifically, this method uses introspection to detect default configuration classes that comply with the constraints required of @Configuration class implementations. If a potential candidate configuration class does not meet these requirements, this method will log a debug message, and the potential candidate class will be ignored.
items.translation: 此方法的实现遵循了SmartContextLoader SPI 中定义的契约。具体而言，该方法使用内省来检测符合@Configuration类实现所需约束的默认配置类。如果潜在候选配置类不满足这些要求，此方法将记录一条调试消息，并忽略该潜在候选类。

items.source: Utility methods for SmartContextLoaders that deal with component classes (for example, @Configuration classes).
items.translation: 用于处理组件类（例如，@Configuration 类）的 SmartContextLoaders 实用方法。

items.source: Detect the default configuration classes for the supplied test class.
items.translation: 检测为提供的测试类配置的默认配置类。

items.source: an array of default configuration classes, potentially empty but never null
items.translation: 一个默认配置类数组，可能为空但永远不会为null。
